content.en:
QwikMart is a hyperlocal quick commerce and eCommerce platform delivering groceries, fresh produce and everyday essentials in minutes, and lifestyle products in days.

Founded in Mumbai, we operate dark stores close to you so your order reaches you faster.
By using QwikMart you agree to these terms. Prices and availability may change without notice. Orders are subject to acceptance and stock availability.

We respect your privacy. We collect only the information needed to process orders and improve our services, and never sell your personal data.

Information we collect

  • Account details (name, phone, email)
  • Delivery addresses and location
  • Order history
Refunds for cancelled orders and approved returns are credited to your QwikMart wallet instantly, or to the original payment method within 5–7 business days on request.
